contract.name: casepath_observable_claim
contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Hello

Without classifying it too early: Yesterday dark water came up through the floor drain again; The manager sent only a cleaner; My photos have no timestamps, and we went to the pharmacy about my daughter's rash; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, my first account covers: the backflow source remains unresolved; for the request “arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the contamination extent; I would like this position reviewed.

My question is: arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs; in particular, I need clarity about the contamination extent and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; I need a clear reply about the backflow source; I can then decide how to proceed.

As far as I remember, it started around 04 October 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Please help me decide what to do: repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it
